parsed.name: 固件烧录服务
parsed.description: 用于通过串口等接口将编译后的固件写入嵌入式设备的烧录软件服务组件，常见于 ESP32 等微控制器开发流程。该组件负责组织烧录参数、端口连接与写入流程，不对应单一硬件厂商设备。
parsed.description_en: A software service component for flashing compiled firmware to embedded devices over serial and related interfaces, commonly used in ESP32 workflows. It manages flashing parameters, port connection, and write procedures, and does not correspond to a single hardware vendor device.

actions.description: 退出当前固件烧录或设备连接界面
actions.description_en: Exit the current firmware flashing or device connection session
